# Recovery.com

> Comprehensive directory of addiction and mental health treatment facilities across the United States, featuring verified pricing, amenities, and accreditation details.

Recovery.com provides detailed profiles of substance use disorder treatment centers, outpatient programs, residential facilities, and behavioral health services. The platform highlights CARF and Joint Commission accredited providers offering medication-assisted treatment (MAT), intensive outpatient programs (IOP), and co-occurring disorder care nationwide.

## Key Topics

- Substance Use Disorder Treatment
- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP)
- CARF Accreditation
- Joint Commission Accreditation
- Co-Occurring Disorders
- Opioid Addiction Treatment
- Mental Health Services
- Outpatient Care
- Residential Treatment
- Peer Recovery Support
- Addiction Recovery
- Methadone Treatment
- Buprenorphine/Suboxone
- Evidence-Based Treatment
